name: micro-scale-fade
title: Micro Scale Fade
desc: A calm, tiny scale pop used as subtle premium polish for labels and headings.

name: milestone-roll
title: Milestone Roll
desc: A counter races through milestones to a 1,000,000 poster over a gradient ground.

name: mobile-paywall
title: Mobile Paywall
desc: A phone paywall selects a plan and shows a Welcome to Pro confirmation.

name: module-count
title: Module Count
desc: A pixel-block number snaps to 48 on a gridded teal ground with a short caption.

name: moire-reveal
title: Moire Reveal
desc: A big 10x resolves out of a moire line pattern with a small pill caption.

name: mondrian-split
title: Mondrian Split
desc: Black lines cut the frame into a seeded De Stijl grid, primaries wipe into its cells, the grid reflows like rubber, and one cell pushes its own lines out past the edges to become a clean color field or the next scene.

name: money-send
title: Money Send
desc: A phone payment screen confirms Sent to Maya with a receipt.

name: mono-settle
title: Mono Settle
desc: Two lines set in monospace settle into proportional type: 'From your editor to the edit.'.

name: mono-voice
title: Mono Voice
desc: Three stacked lines shift voice mid-line, ending in a large accent 'delivery.'.

name: moves-up
title: Moves Up
desc: A Now/Next/Later roadmap list where the current item moves up and enlarges.

name: multi-file-drop
title: Multi File Drop
desc: Files drop into a prompt box as chips, then a cursor presses send.

name: multiplayer-cursors
title: Multiplayer Cursors
desc: Collaborator cursors drop stickies, select cards and comment on a shared board.

name: mvp-card
title: Mvp Card
desc: A player card slams open with logo and counting stats beside a giant gradient 'MVP'.

name: name-gloss
title: Name Gloss
desc: Two big words, "Brand kit", each get a small gloss line and a closing teal sentence.

name: ndot-resolve
title: Ndot Resolve
desc: A headline scans in as a dot-matrix face, then refreshes letter by letter into solid type.

name: negation-drop
title: Negation Drop
desc: Condensed caps poster where each line's key word drops in on a lime highlight block.

name: neon-sign
title: Neon Sign
desc: A glass neon tube stutters alive segment by segment with a hot white core and wall glow, buzzes off once, then holds lit.

name: neural-pulse
title: Neural Pulse
desc: A neural network fires a prompt through its nodes and resolves into the Remocn logo.

name: no-buts
title: No Buts
desc: A hesitant "But..." is answered by a yellow "Go on. We'll wait.".

name: node-trail
title: Node Trail
desc: A prompt node trails dotted lines into a workflow graph: script, scenes, render, publish.

name: noise-forge-sting
title: Noise Forge Sting
desc: The Remocn wordmark forges out of noise on a warm glow, tagline fading in below.

name: nonstop
title: Nonstop
desc: A stops counter ticks down from three until the line resolves to the big phrase 'No stops'.

name: not-yet
title: Not Yet
desc: A stack of "It can't ... Yet." lines, the last one brightest, each ending in an orange "Yet.".

name: notification-avalanche
title: Notification Avalanche
desc: Notifications pile onto a lock screen, group into a stack, then clear to All caught up.

name: now-playing
title: Now Playing
desc: A music player with lyrics highlights a line on a colored gradient background.

name: number-mosaic
title: Number Mosaic
desc: A field of square pixels organizes into the number 10,000 with a caption below.

name: number-split
title: Number Split
desc: A big 300+ splits down a bracket into four category counts on colored bars.

name: number-wheel
title: Number Wheel
desc: Mechanical odometer that rolls an integer up or down to its target, direction inferred from the values.

name: off-the-charts
title: Off The Charts
desc: Quarterly bars climb until the last one breaks its axis and overshoots the target at 260%.

name: on-approach
title: on Approach
desc: 'Wheels up' stays fixed while the time phrase swaps from 'in June' down to 'today.'.

name: onboarding-stepper-flow
title: UI Onboarding Stepper Flow
desc: A multi-step onboarding composition: a horizontal stepper advances through panels of input, radio, and switch fields, finishing on a Finish button that runs to success. Panel crossfade derives linearly from the stepper's exposed position channel; every other channel comes from a composed primitive's hook.

name: opencode
title: OpenCode
desc: Animated OpenCode TUI welcome screen — two-tone wordmark, an input box with a blue accent bar that types a query, a model status line, and command hints. Dark/light themes.

name: orbit-lock
title: Orbit Lock
desc: Three moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a red core that bursts into a ring flash and springs the logo into place.

name: out-of-context
title: Out of Context
desc: "Stop making launch videos by hand." with the last words in pink on a blue ground.

name: outline-fill-track-text
title: Outline Fill Track Text
desc: A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills from left to right while both travel on one continuous track.

name: outline-trace
title: Outline Trace
desc: Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it.

name: oval-type
title: Oval Type
desc: Each word rides inside its own glossy gradient capsule, finishing as a three-capsule poster.

name: overheard
title: Overheard
desc: A question quote, "Who made our launch video?", answered by "I did. It's in the repo.".

name: overnight
title: Overnight
desc: A dated story line, "The demo went up before the launch post did.", on a yellow ground.

name: packed-count
title: Packed Count
desc: A big blue counter reaches 41,900 with digits packing tight, caption above.

name: page-turn
title: Page Turn
desc: The exiting scene swings up and away like a notebook page in stop-motion poses, staying above the scene it reveals.

name: panel-split
title: Panel Split
desc: A portfolio page splits into stacked panels of bio, case study and reel.

name: paper-plane
title: Paper Plane
desc: A dotted flight path loops past three stops and lands on the Remocn wordmark.

name: paper-sticker
title: Paper Sticker
desc: A taped paper chip that slaps onto the scene over two stop-motion poses, keeping a hand-placed tilt and per-pose wobble.

name: paper-tear
title: Paper Tear
desc: A jagged rip runs down the frame, then both halves peel apart on a spring with white fibrous torn edges, revealing the scene underneath.

name: paper-wobble
title: Paper Wobble
desc: Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk.

name: parallax-depth
title: Parallax Depth
desc: A flat landscape built from depth layers trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones.

name: parallax-lockup
title: Parallax Lockup
desc: A three-line headline locks up with parallax, the last line in a gradient.

name: particle-dissolve
title: Particle Dissolve
desc: The frame is ground into drifting grey dust whose specks carry real fragments of the picture, and the next scene coalesces back out of the same dust.

name: pass-swap
title: Pass Swap
desc: An object passes across the frame and each pass swaps the headline to the next one.

name: path-ride
title: Path Ride
desc: A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline.

name: path-search
title: Path Search
desc: A pathfinding search floods a grid and traces the route from start to goal.

name: path-text
title: Path Text
desc: Text starts along a loose path then straightens into a clean line with an italic tail.

name: pattern-tile
title: Pattern Tile
desc: A quarter-disc tile is rotated, mirrored and translated into a wall of 72 tiles.

name: peek-shut
title: Peek Shut
desc: "Want a peek?" is cut off by a shutter: "That's all you get. The rest, Monday.".

name: pendulum-wave
title: Pendulum Wave
desc: A row of pendulums with tuned periods drifts from a straight line into waves and braids, then realigns for a seamless loop.

name: per-character-rise
title: Per Character Rise
desc: Letters slide up from below with no blur — crisp, deliberate, kinetic.

name: per-word-crossfade
title: Per-Word Crossfade
desc: Words gently fade into place one after another, with a short vertical drift for a calm keynote rhythm.

name: period-drop
title: Period Drop
desc: A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period.

name: perlin-dissolve
title: Perlin Dissolve
desc: A perlin-noise shader transition that sweeps its noise threshold to dissolve one scene into the next.

name: perspective-marquee
title: Perspective Marquee
desc: A 3D-tilted infinite marquee with depth-of-field blur on items rolling toward the horizon.

name: perspective-squeeze
title: Perspective Squeeze
desc: Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes.

name: phone-scroll
title: Phone Scroll
desc: A phone app screen flicks through stops while a headline sits beside it.

name: phone-trio
title: Phone Trio
desc: Three phones side by side show a notification, a photo feed and a profile.

name: photo-caret
title: Photo Caret
desc: A three-line headline types out with a caret while product photos float around it.

name: photo-fill-type
title: Photo Fill Type
desc: A word cut out of the stage reveals a generated mountain landscape and a caption.

name: photo-halo
title: Photo Halo
desc: The Remocn wordmark sits next to a halo of circular photo thumbnails.

name: phrase-list-bridge
title: Phrase List Bridge
desc: An inline highlight chip bridges two phrases: "Browse through ... ready-made scenes".

name: phyllotaxis
title: Phyllotaxis
desc: Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then an accent Fibonacci arm pulses outward.

name: pill-morph
title: Pill Morph
desc: A logo pill opens into a product card, splits into feature pills and becomes an app tile.

name: pinned-word
title: Pinned Word
desc: A serif italic word is pinned in a sentence while the rest changes, 'Own every video frame.'.

name: pitch-blanks
title: Pitch Blanks
desc: A fill-in-the-blank pitch where product, category and audience labels annotate each underlined phrase.

name: pitch-over
title: Pitch Over
desc: A large number counts to 7,200 with a ruler of ticks and a marker sliding beneath it.

name: pixel-bars
title: Pixel Bars
desc: LED-style pixel bars climb, the last column lighting orange and blue to +64%.

name: pixel-sort
title: Pixel Sort
desc: The scene melts into seeded vertical streaks like glitch-art pixel sorting, then the next scene's columns fall in and snap into place.

name: pixelate-region
title: Pixelate Region
desc: Cover rectangles of a scene with an opaque mosaic while the rest passes through untouched — redact keys, addresses and personal data before a demo goes out.

name: plain-license
title: Plain License
desc: A big green "Free," then "for anyone, for anything." in condensed type.

name: play-of-the-game
title: Play of The Game
desc: A 'Play of the Game' banner slices in over the remocn logo with a role label and stat.

name: plus-open
title: Plus Open
desc: A plus sign opens into the next statement on a soft aurora ground, 'Here's everything new.'.

name: point-expand
title: Point Expand
desc: Short statements land one at a time, ending 'Copy, paste, render.' with a pulsing accent period.

name: point-hop
title: Point Hop
desc: A decimal figure 34.2 with a pink point that hops between digits, then a unit like microseconds.

name: point-intro
title: Point Intro
desc: A headline is written word by word and a colored point lands after it: 'Introducing remocn 2.0.'.

name: polaroid
title: Polaroid
desc: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.

name: popover
title: UI Popover
desc: A popover/hover-card whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline. The Popover renderer is a pure function of a PopoverStyle (opacity, scale, translate); usePopoverTransition eases both the open and the close. The static `side` prop sets the enter translate axis; renders title + description and/or arbitrary children in a popover card.

name: post-script
title: Post Script
desc: A red card with a "Thanks for watching" line and a "P.S. The next launch film is yours.".

name: poster-crop
title: Poster Crop
desc: A poster headline crops in tight, line by line, over a ruled blue ground.

name: pov-setup
title: POV Setup
desc: A 'POV:' setup line slides in word by word, then a serif italic punchline lands.

name: pr-merge
title: PR Merge
desc: A pull request is approved and merged, then its branch is deleted.

name: press-stat
title: Press Stat
desc: A mono caption presses out and a huge green 73% lands beside 'Edit time down'.

name: press-warp-dive
title: Press Warp Dive
desc: A button press warps and dives into a video player, landing on the next scene.

name: price-page
title: Price Page
desc: A huge teal "Free." fills the frame with "That's the whole pricing page.".

name: price-slate
title: Price Slate
desc: A price reel spins to land on $0 with the old $29 struck through.

name: pricing-reveal
title: Pricing Reveal
desc: A pricing table highlights the Pro plan and strikes the old price for the new one.

name: progress
title: UI Progress
desc: A progress bar whose fill is a pure function of a numeric value channel (value-channel deviation). The Progress renderer takes a clamped 0–100 value; useProgressTransition reads the frame and eases the fill between value steps. Muted track + primary indicator, optional floored percentage label.

name: prompt-restyle
title: Prompt Restyle
desc: A headline is restyled by prompt instructions, ending in a serif italic gradient 'you own'.

name: prompt-swell
title: Prompt Swell
desc: A prompt swells into a builder that generates a pricing page with checklist and waitlist form.

name: prompt-to-app
title: Prompt to App
desc: A prompt types into a chat and a site preview builds as files are written.

name: pull-in
title: Pull in
desc: 'Now in' stays put while spaced-out place words pull into view, such as vertical, 4K, your codebase.

name: pulse-line
title: Pulse Line
desc: A heartbeat-style pulse runs through 'Every frame has a pulse.' with the last word in teal.

name: push-through
title: Push Through
desc: A dolly transition that blows the outgoing scene past the camera while the next one approaches from the depth.
